note: Both sets capture the core Flexinol force figures (2500 g martensite, 2900 g austenite, 400 g total), the 32-of-64 louver counts and the 30%/12% heating/cooling loads, and both share the same questionable chart readings (Ms 50 C at 50 at% Ni, -100 C at 53 at% Ni) and the same misquoted "specified wire provided..." quote. Set A adds several defective claims: two entries whose value is just the axis label "Ms °C" with no number, a misbound "spring | force | 2500 gram" (the 2500 g load is on the wire, not the spring), louver counts attributed to the "Flexnoll® actuator" instead of the screen bay/wire with "openable" misquotes, and a duplicated, misbound "operating temperature range" claim. Set B is cleaner and adds two useful, well-supported chart claims (hysteresis behavior; Ms temperature decreasing with increasing nickel content) that A omits. B's only real defects are the shared misquote, the unsupported -100 C at 53 at% Ni point, and a label-only "Ms, Mf, As, Af" value.
